coverage_notes: SEALED_FIXTURE/SEALED_ANSWER access is evaluator-only -- a non-evaluator (development agent, learning pipeline, or public requester) is denied outright, satisfying '개발 Agent/학습 파이프라인에 노출 금지'. Exposure is modeled as one-way: any grant of a sealed field, even to a legitimate evaluator, permanently flips blind_authority_retained to false -- satisfying '노출·유출되면 해당 set의 blind qualification authority를 즉시 폐기한다' exactly, including that the loss is irreversible (a later request can never re-seal an already-exposed set).
